sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered sequence of boat-sized placements from the initial rectangle to the selected reachable dead end.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Enumerate placements where the full boat rectangle fits, retain the start-connected placement graph, choose the dead end nearest the destination, and reconstruct its unique route.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Move the boat to that endpoint and recolor only corridor cells swept by the selected route, excluding the final boat, to 9.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The reachable graph has unused branches. Marking every reachable placement rather than the selected start-to-end route changes the protected final grid.
